Key Takeaways
Income
✓Total Income in 1Q26 increased by 0.2% 
YoY, driven by an increase in ARR of True 
Tower 1 Project
Expenses
✓Total expenses in 1Q26 decreased by 4.3% 
YoY, with the details shown below:
➢Operational expenses decreased by 3.9% 
YoY, primarily due to the reduction in 
utility expenses
➢Professional fees increased by 1.7% YoY, 
driven by higher property management 
fees, in line with the Trust’s performance
➢Financial costs decreased by 17.7% YoY 
due to a decrease in principal  from the 
repayment schedule and lower interest 
rates
➢Net increase in net assets rose by 6.8% 
YoY, primarily driven by the result of the 
adjustment of accrued income under 
operating leases
